About us

A building company that brings order to the work

Edilnova exists to make building maintenance simpler: few promises, well-documented work.

We work with condominiums, families and businesses on facades, balconies, roofs, waterproofing and renovations. Every job starts with a check and ends with a documented handover.

Our principles

1Clarity

What we do and why, written down before we start.

2Tidy sites

Planned work and spaces left in order.

3Documentation

Photos and a report for every major job.
